goal: Populate BIP 174 global xpubs in wallet PSBTs for descriptors with multiple keys
Allow stateless hardware signers to recognize multisig setups and sign directly
reviewability: Author has not responded to major architectural objections
agreement: Unaddressed objection: global xpubs should not be restricted to multisig (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: API should return maps directly and support MuSig (achow101)
Noted utility for non-HWI flows and clarified device requirements (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes an issue where hardware signers refuse to sign multisig PSBTs
Stateless devices like BitBox02 require global xpubs and otherwise need manual workarounds
